answer: Before each monthly payout, every account must join a ten-minute check-in window opening for everyone at the same moment. The screen shows an onyx ring beside a jade cup and speaks an instruction, like raising one hand, which the holder must mirror on camera. Two reviewers compare the recording with earlier ones within a day. Missing the window pauses the payout, and two accounts showing the same face or room are closed. One honest user spends ten minutes a month; 1,000 fake accounts would need 1,000 different people live at the same instant.
